svg.title: Gibbs: Metal-native inference engine
svg.desc: Ordered-dithered 1895 photograph of J. Willard Gibbs in brass tones with a pipe whose ember glows and smoke rises, the GIBBS wordmark, and four measured figures from the README benchmark: roofline geomean 50.6%, Gemma 4 E2B QAT 143 tok/s, streaming ceiling 293 GB/s, peak 459 tok/s.
svg.text: APPLE M5 PRO · METAL · BUILD B7269AE · 2026-10-20 · ONE GIBBS --BENCH PROCESS PER BENCH/LOOP.JSON ROW (SUITE DEFAULTS: 128 TOKENS, 3 RUNS)
